text: Each letter is shifted by its column's letter of one key word and by its row's letter of a second key. Inside a row the row letter is the same for neighbours, so doubled letters can only collect in particular columns, as K4's do in rows of seven.
Two known letters in one row differ by the difference of their column letters; the same two columns one row down must differ by the same amount. In rows of 7 the first such pair already disagrees.
Every width 2-48, both tables, with no scrambling and after or before 27,754 scramblings: nothing fits beyond what scrambled coppers show.
